message.text: web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts uses memoServiceClient from @/connect. Verifying this is the correct module for memo CRUD mutations and queries.
The frontend module is `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts`. It uses the generated service client `memoServiceClient`.

q17.
web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts; memoServiceClient

That module exports the memo React Query hooks (`useMemos`, `useMemo`, `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, and related comment/link hooks). It imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts`), which is the generated ConnectRPC `MemoService` client.
